## [2026-04-03 ~20:00] — PR #3 comprehensive review + 6-phase resolution implementation

**Project(s):** MechDSL (mechdsl-core)

### Decisions
- Ran 5 specialized review agents (code, tests, errors, comments, types) + Gemini Code Assist on PR #3, producing `dev/reviews/pr3_bm.md`
- C2 design: Made quadrature loop `ti.static` (not `ti.field` restructure) — pragmatic choice, N_QP=8 is element-type constant, fits JIT budget. Convention docs updated with carve-out.
- C5 design: Node loops changed to runtime `range(N_NODES)` except GRAD_AT_QUAD gather which stays `ti.static` for Python list access
- H1 design: NaN propagation strategy for J2 non-convergence (dl=NaN → stress → residual → C4b guard catches with np.isfinite)
- G1: Rigid body rotation tolerance tightened from 1e-2*MU to 1e-10 — Green-Lagrange strain is rotationally invariant
- G3: Dirichlet BC tangent changed from zeroing to identity (Kv[bc_mask] = v[bc_mask]) for CG non-singularity
- G4: Elastic FD tangent tolerance tightened from 1e-4 to 1e-8, plastic kept at 1e-4
- Codex review caught: hydrostatic strains in tests never yield (zero deviatoric stress) — fixed to uniaxial
- Codex review caught: res_norm unbound on max_iter=0 — fixed with sentinel initialization
